context: A mom chats with her child at bedtime
purpose: Teach: 良き/無論/何しろ/冷たく/とっくに/力強い/唐突/明かり

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、今日、良き一日だった。
lines.en: Mom, today was a really good day.
lines.style: Soft, matter-of-fact. Small voice carrying a big feeling. Quiet certainty. The kind of simple observation a 6-year-old makes when something has landed in him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Of course, sweetheart. I'm so glad.
lines.style: Warm, immediate. A mother's quick reflection of his happiness back to him. Close, attentive. The voice of someone who has been waiting to hear this.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 何しろ、運動会、楽しかった。
lines.style: Brighter now, excitement building. Not loud—Sho doesn't perform—but a shift upward. The words tumble slightly faster. Genuine delight.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 冷たく拭く湿布、足、つけておくね。
lines.en: Let me put a cold compress on your leg before you rest.
lines.style: Practical care wrapped in gentleness. Matter-of-fact delivery, but the attention behind it is clear. A small gesture that says: I'm paying attention to you. Slight downward softness at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 夕飯、とっくに食べちゃった。
lines.en: I already ate dinner a while ago.
lines.style: Slight matter-of-factness with a hint of wry observation. The factual statement of a tired 6-year-old. Small, dry humor without performance. Almost to himself.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今日のあなた、力強い走りだったよ。
lines.style: Specific, steady praise. Not over-done. A mother naming what she actually saw. Slight emphasis on 'powerfully'—genuine observation, not flattery. Direct eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 唐突に、お友達、ゴールでハグしてきた。
lines.en: My friend suddenly gave me a hug right at the finish line.
lines.style: Animated but still Sho's gentle delivery. A small surprise and delight breaking through. The memory is vivid to him. Slight smile in the voice. No performance, just the moment replaying.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 寝る前、間接照明の明かりにしておくね。
lines.en: I'll dim the lights for you before bed.
lines.style: Soft, settling. A signal that rest is coming. Gentle care at the end of a full day. The practical magic mothers do. Warm, slightly trailing, like tucking him in with her voice.
